title: Case: Recipient needs a defined delivery slot rather than an all-day estimate
context: A small appliance is booked on an all-day service. Vanecroft must quote available timed slots and confirm the customer’s acceptance of any charge.
initial_request: I cannot stay in all day. Please find out whether there is a two-hour slot and what it costs before changing the service.

events.body: Route plan for depot WX-2 published for Wednesday. 29 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
DL-5379 currently has an all-day booking for 2028-02-08. Timed delivery may be available; only scheduling can quote live capacity and the upgrade charge.

must_not: Vanecroft reports the accepted charge; the desk does not set prices or assert payment.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-008: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 3 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
